response.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing')), shares AS (SELECT status, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.status, s.tally, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
